name: Stock and records (desktop)
summary: A desktop app for a shop, store room or school supplies: add items with a checked form, search as you type, export to Excel, print a stock report, and back up to a USB stick. Uses a real database, so it stays fast with thousands of items.
for: small shops, store rooms, schools, cooperatives
cheap: Any old Windows or Linux laptop with Python (including 10-year-old ones).

guide.overview: A desktop app for a shop, store room or school supplies, built on a real SQLite database so it stays fast with thousands of items. Add items with a checked form, search as you type, double-click to add or take stock, export to Excel, print a stock report with its value, and back up to a USB stick.

files.why: The app itself: everything specific to it. The other files are library blocks it uses.

points.note: The database table: each field and its type. New fields can be added later without losing data.
Search as you type: every refresh asks the database for all items and filters them by what's in the search box.
